Description uses 'mittelblau' (medium blue) for 'Wasserversorgung', but the atom specifies 'dunkelblau' (dark blue).

The description does not explicitly mention that the segments are color-coded and labeled, though this is implied.
The description claims 14 segments, but the figure shows 13 distinct categories (atoms list 13 categories).
